raw_text: BREAKING: Chinese Type 055 guided-missile destroyer spotted entering Indian Ocean via Malacca Strait. Indian Navy deploying P-8I Poseidon for long-range maritime surveillance. This is a 13,000-ton warship with 112 VLS cells — the most powerful surface combatant China has sent to IOR. Task group exercise likely planned in eastern Indian Ocean.
